title: Sony WH-CH520 Wireless Headphones
description: Sony WH-CH520 wireless headphones with 30-hour battery life, lightweight foldable design, and clear hands-free calling with built-in microphone.

reviews.author: Neha P.
reviews.title: Great bass for the price
reviews.body: Sony sound signature is evident even at this price point. Comfortable for long listening sessions.

reviews.author: Rohit T.
reviews.title: Good battery life
reviews.body: 30 hours is real. Quick charging works well. ANC is average but enough for office.

reviews.author: Simran K.
reviews.title: Decent but could be better
reviews.body: Sound is decent for casual music. Build feels mostly plastic but hinges are sturdy.
